Specification: This module specifies a very small transition system over a single variable x, with an initial state x = 0 and two actions A and B that constrain current and next-state values of x. The main step relation Next is defined using the action composition operator A \cdot B, so the specification is focused on sequential composition of actions rather than ordinary disjunctive next-state structure. The file defines a standard safety-style temporal specification Spec with Init and [][Next]_x, as well as an invariant Inv, an enabledness-related state predicate Inv2, and temporal properties involving the composition B \cdot A and Next.
